name: Storybook
summary: Develop and document components in isolation, outside the application.
what_it_is: A workshop environment that renders components in isolation with controllable props, doubling as living documentation and a base for visual regression and interaction testing.
why_it_matters: Storybook is most valuable where a design system crosses a team boundary — it gives designers and other engineers a place to see what actually exists without running the app. It carries a real and frequently underestimated cost: it is a second build to configure and maintain, and an abandoned Storybook is worse than none because it documents the past.
suitable_for: Design systems and shared component libraries
Teams where designers review components directly
Components hard to reach through normal app navigation
not_suitable_for: Small applications with few reusable components
Teams without capacity to keep stories current
Projects where the second build configuration is not worth the benefit
alternatives: a plain in-app component gallery route
verifiable_facts: Official docs describe isolated component rendering with controllable props, plus testing integrations.
editorial_interpretation: That an abandoned Storybook is worse than none.
